summary: Glucotrack, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-15 reverse stock split effective August 28, 2026, approved by stockholders on August 18, 2026. Outstanding shares reduced from 11,972,157 to ~798,144; no fractional shares issued; round-up to whole share. Authorized shares remain 250,000,000. Trading begins on split-adjusted basis August 31, 2026; ticker GCTK unchanged; new CUSIP 45824Q887. VStock Transfer acts as exchange agent. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation; no deal terms applicable.
